title: Composter
html:
Composter

  • Stats
  • Info

Region

Flowering Meadows

Shop

Flora Laura

Price

10,760$

Function

Сreates dirt by putting a lot of flowers, plants into the Composter.

Version Added

1.66.2

Date Added

August 30th, 2024


Description

"Fill up with plant matter to produce dirt! Dirt will always come out where the arrow faces."

Method of application

  • With dirt, you can refine and can forge it. Also, you can fill schematics with it.

Players can throw any flowers and fruits into the composter and the like.

Attention: Filling a composter can be difficult, you really need a lot of resources to fill at least 1 composter.

Tip: A single Tumbleweed, Cattail or Water Lily can fill the entire composter instantly.

Once the composter is completely full, you will not be able to load any biomaterials into it, then you had to wait about 1 minute or a little more, and then a lump of earth will form next to it, and the composter itself will be empty.









Composting

Each plant in the game has different composting levels and percentages; you can check the percentage of how much your composter got filled by a plant by using a Statistic Tool.
